m1 - STATUS: everything green except the golden, which awaits the chief's authorization to re-cut.

  alignJVM  200/200
  codecJVM  107/107   after carrying supportWeight through CostBreakdownWire, the encoder, the
                      decoder, and the checked reconstruction
  only WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenResourceSuite fails, because the wire record gained a key per cell

I CHECKED THAT MY OWN FIELD IS NOT INERT, which is the thing I would have asked of anyone else's carrier. Measured across 46 cells: supportWeight takes exactly two values, 0.9552 and 1.0000. The 0.9552 is 3.2/3.35 to four places, which is precisely the eligible-support fraction of a five-term cell, and it appears on u1 and u2 - the two units with no sensory term. u0 and u3 are 1.0000 throughout because they supply one.

Both values appear within u1 and u2 because their EXTERNAL cells carry 1.0 - external states never reach the blend, so they have no terms and no assumed support. That is the correct reading rather than a leak: an external cost assumes nothing.

So the field varies, varies for the right reason, and takes the arithmetically predicted value. Had it been 1.0 everywhere the whole change would have been theatre and this is where I would have found out.

RE-DERIVED THE TWO SIGNATURE LITERALS against 855b754 rather than carrying them over. Values identical to my pre-rebase measurement, confirming the scout's landing and mine are orthogonal - checked twice now, on both sides of the rebase, because I had predicted they might interact.

AND THE TEST CORRECTED ME ONCE MORE. I wrote a comment asserting mean-of-ratios did NOT move, on the reasoning that it depends on localizability alone and is blind to a mass reweighting. Wrong: WHICH ROWS ARE LOCALIZABLE is itself a function of the posterior. It moved 0.628359 -> 0.635733. I have now pinned the GAP as well, 0.049861 -> 0.051288, so a future change that moves both formulas together still fails here rather than sliding through an inequality.

Cross-platform gate running. Golden held pending authorization.
